input_zh: 基于 main 提交 298eba1ff24d45e2556639fc5ef91cd03ffb4f21 声明的 Worker Control V1.1.0 完成 Reading 的 Fail-closed Admission；确定性核验生成版 Reading Prompt 的 SHA-256 为 f02aac1b6ff0008fceb1285fd418afaa628db5072ad54072ee3b85c300e6e167，并从同一提交完整读取其五个 Required Source；同时使用已远程核验的 2026-08-13 Reading Wake Receipt、已持久完成的同日 Queue、恰好包含 Q-20260813-01 / Q-20260813-02 / Q-20260813-03 的同日 Today's Research Plan，以及三个已选一手提交与其直接关联的一手仓库上下文。未把前一日 Reading Result 或 Research Object 作为当天输入。
workResult: Completed Skill 03 primary-source Deep Reading for all three same-date selected objects only after Runtime reconciliation opened Reading as the earliest due unfinished task and a fresh Worker Claimed event was durably verified. Q-20260813-01 verified that Google ADK confirmation resume reconstructs the flow-level transfer_to_agent capability from the current LlmAgent transfer targets before resolving/re-executing the confirmed call; approved and rejected paths both require the tool to be resolvable, while no current transfer target means no injected transfer capability. Q-20260813-02 verified Codex gRPC code-mode recovery through a replaceable session binding, single-flight reopening, generation-scoped public cell IDs, generation-aware callbacks, shutdown coordination and stale-generation rejection; old in-flight work is interrupted rather than migrated. Q-20260813-03 verified Codex local streamable-HTTP MCP header helpers as a bounded, cached, origin-scoped local execution boundary with redirect stopping, reserved/duplicate header rejection, local/managed policy gates, sanitized environment, process containment, CLI redaction and OAuth/startup coverage. Three durable Reading Notes were produced. No Research Analysis, article drafting, visualization or publication was performed.
workResult_zh: 仅在 Runtime Reconciliation 将 Reading 判定为最早到期未收口任务并持久核验新的 Worker Claimed 后，才对三个同日已选对象执行 Skill 03 一手来源 Deep Reading。Q-20260813-01 核验了 Google ADK 在 Confirmation Resume 时，会基于当前 LlmAgent 的 Transfer Target 重建 Flow-level `transfer_to_agent` 能力，再解析并重新执行确认调用；批准与拒绝路径都要求原工具可解析，而当前不存在 Transfer Target 时不会注入该能力。Q-20260813-02 核验了 Codex gRPC Code Mode 通过可替换 Session Binding、Single-flight Reopen、Generation-scoped Public Cell ID、Generation-aware Callback、Shutdown Coordination 与 Stale-generation Rejection 恢复 Host 替换后的缓存 Session；旧 Host 上正在进行的工作会中断，而不是迁移到新 Host。Q-20260813-03 核验了 Codex 本地 Streamable-HTTP MCP Header Helper 作为有界、缓存、Origin-scoped 的本地执行边界，包含停止 Redirect、拒绝 Reserved/Duplicate Header、Local/Managed Policy Gate、清理环境、进程 containment、CLI Redaction，以及 OAuth/Startup 测试覆盖。共形成 3 份持久 Reading Note。未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化或发布。
